newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.

text.p: Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5450/42.5500 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5375/42.5475, dealers said.
The taka was quoted lower at 42.5425/42.5525 in early trading becaue of a short supply of dollars and higher demand from state-owned banks preparing for import payments.
Dealers said some of the banks had to buy dollars from the central bank after the rates touched the ceiling of the official band of 42.35/42.55 in interbank trading.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.5 percent to 5.0 percent against the previous 5.0-5.5 percent, they said.
